title: Zesty Smoky Vietnamese Almond Spring-Rolls
description: A festive, nutty spring roll that blends the umami depth of doenjang with cold smoked flavors, all wrapped in fresh rice paper and cooked gently in a tagine pot for a pillowy texture.
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine doenjang, lemon juice, and smoked paprika until smooth.
Add shredded chicken, cabbage, carrot, and green onion to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the sauce.
Lightly toast almond slivers in a dry skillet until fragrant, then fold them into the mixture.
Warm a pot with a thin layer of oil over low heat, then disperse the mixture evenly across the bottom.
Cover the pot with a lid and let the mixture steam gently for 8 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
While the filling steams, soak each rice paper sheet in warm water for 15 seconds until pliable.
Place a spoonful of the cooked filling onto the center of each softened sheet.
Fold the sides inward, then roll tightly from the bottom to encase the filling, sealing the edge with a pinch of water.
Arrange the rolled spring rolls in a single layer on a plate, optionally drizzle with a drizzle of lime‑infused water.
Serve immediately, or chill the rolls in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving for a cold smoked finish.
